arguments.content:
CXX       := clang++
CXXFLAGS  := -std=c++23 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Iinclude
LDFLAGS   :=

TARGET    := epilog
BUILD_DIR := build
TEST_DIR  := tests

# ---- Source lists ----------------------------------------------------------

SRCS_INTERNALS := $(wildcard internals/*.cpp)
SRCS_PARSER    := $(wildcard parser/*.cpp)
SRCS_ENGINE    := $(wildcard engine/*.cpp)
SRCS_ROOT      := main.cpp repl.cpp

OBJS_INTERNALS := $(patsubst internals/%.cpp, $(BUILD_DIR)/internals/%.o, $(SRCS_INTERNALS))
OBJS_PARSER    := $(patsubst parser/%.cpp,    $(BUILD_DIR)/parser/%.o,    $(SRCS_PARSER))
OBJS_ENGINE    := $(patsubst engine/%.cpp,    $(BUILD_DIR)/engine/%.o,    $(SRCS_ENGINE))
OBJS_ROOT      := $(patsubst %.cpp,           $(BUILD_DIR)/%.o,            $(SRCS_ROOT))

# Shared object files (everything except main.o) linked into each test binary
# epilog_ffi.cpp is included here so FFI tests can be written if desired.
LIB_OBJS := $(OBJS_INTERNALS) $(OBJS_PARSER) $(OBJS_ENGINE) \
            $(BUILD_DIR)/repl.o

TEST_SRCS := $(wildcard $(TEST_DIR)/test_*.cpp)
TEST_BINS := $(patsubst $(TEST_DIR)/%.cpp, $(BUILD_DIR)/tests/%, $(TEST_SRCS))

ALL_OBJS := $(OBJS_INTERNALS) $(OBJS_PARSER) $(OBJS_ENGINE) $(OBJS_ROOT)

# ---- Shared library (for FFI consumers: C, Python, Odin, …) ---------------
#
#   make shared       → build/libepilог.so   (Linux/macOS)
#   make shared_win   → build/epilog.dll     (Windows via clang-cl or MinGW)
#
# The shared lib exposes only epilog_ffi.h symbols.  The engine objects and
# internal headers are not part of the public ABI.

SHARED_OBJS := $(OBJS_INTERNALS) $(OBJS_PARSER) $(OBJS_ENGINE)

LIB_NAME_SO  := $(BUILD_DIR)/libepilог.so
LIB_NAME_DLL := $(BUILD_DIR)/epilog.dll

# ---- Phony targets ---------------------------------------------------------

.PHONY: all release debug clean test coverage shared shared_win

all: release

release: CXXFLAGS += -O2 -DNDEBUG
release: $(TARGET)

debug: CXXFLAGS += -g -O0 -DDEBUG
debug: $(TARGET)

# ---- Main binary -----------------------------------------------------------

$(TARGET): $(ALL_OBJS)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $^ -o $@ $(LDFLAGS)

# ---- Shared library (Linux / macOS) ----------------------------------------

shared: CXXFLAGS += -O2 -DNDEBUG -fPIC
shared: $(SHARED_OBJS)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -shared $^ -o $(LIB_NAME_SO) $(LDFLAGS)
	@echo "Built $(LIB_NAME_SO)"

# ---- Shared library (Windows DLL) -----------------------------------------
#
#   Requires clang++ with lld-link or a MinGW toolchain.
#   Exports are controlled by epilog_ffi.h (all extern "C" symbols).

shared_win: CXXFLAGS += -O2 -DNDEBUG
shared_win: $(SHARED_OBJS)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -shared \
	    -Wl,/DEF:epilog_ffi.def \
	    $^ -o $(LIB_NAME_DLL) $(LDFLAGS)
	@echo "Built $(LIB_NAME_DLL)"

# ---- Tests -----------------------------------------------------------------

test: CXXFLAGS += -g -O0
test: $(LIB_OBJS) $(TEST_BINS)
	@echo ""
	@echo "=== Running tests ==="
	@PASS=0; FAIL=0; \
	for bin in $(TEST_BINS); do \
	    echo "--- $$bin ---"; \
	    if $$bin; then PASS=$$((PASS+1)); else FAIL=$$((FAIL+1)); fi; \
	done; \
	echo ""; \
	echo "=== $$PASS suite(s) passed, $$FAIL suite(s) failed ==="; \
	[ $$FAIL -eq 0 ]

# ---- Coverage --------------------------------------------------------------

coverage: CXXFLAGS += -g -O0 --coverage -fprofile-arcs -ftest-coverage
coverage: LDFLAGS  += --coverage
coverage: $(LIB_OBJS) $(TEST_BINS)
	@echo ""
	@echo "=== Running tests for coverage ==="
	@for bin in $(TEST_BINS); do $$bin || true; done
	@echo ""
	@echo "=== Generating coverage report ==="
	llvm-cov gcov $(SRCS_INTERNALS) $(SRCS_PARSER) $(SRCS_ENGINE) \
	    --object-directory=$(BUILD_DIR) 2>/dev/null || true
	@echo "Coverage .gcov files written to current directory."

# ---- Compile rules ---------------------------------------------------------

$(BUILD_DIR)/internals/%.o: internals/%.cpp
	@mkdir -p $(dir $@)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

$(BUILD_DIR)/parser/%.o: parser/%.cpp
	@mkdir -p $(dir $@)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

$(BUILD_DIR)/engine/%.o: engine/%.cpp
	@mkdir -p $(dir $@)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o: %.cpp
	@mkdir -p $(dir $@)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

$(BUILD_DIR)/tests/%: $(TEST_DIR)/%.cpp $(LIB_OBJS)
	@mkdir -p $(dir $@)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -I$(TEST_DIR) $^ -o $@

clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD_DIR) $(TARGET) $(TARGET).exe *.gcov *.gcda *.gcno \
	       $(LIB_NAME_SO) $(LIB_NAME_DLL)
